10:38 < Filip_> year-ending  ==  trying to finish a lot of projects
10:39 < jal0> been doing some hardware tracing, found that the CASIO CAK2007 is the touch screen digitizer / decoder. And that the touch screen itself is a 4-wire resistive touch panel
10:40 < Filip_> CAK2007=  ADC ?
10:40 < jal0> i have about half of the pins traced so far, still not sure if its serial or usb, as those are the two most common types
10:41 < jal0> yeah, in a way
10:42 < jal0> http://www.kyocera.com/kicc/lcd/notes/touchpanels.htm   <--- has some links on the technoloy behind the touch-panels
10:42 < Filip_> so what would go into the companion (or cpu?)  ,  serial/usb data or just two 16bit values, one  for  x and one for y
10:42 < Filip_> brb
10:42 < jal0> serial/usb
10:42 < jal0> me too have to take the wife to work
10:55 < jal0> back
10:57 < jal0> you there?
11:14 < jal0> filip: the touch screen controller is connected to the companion. figures, what would be useful if i had a reference board that used the CASIO CAK2007 directly. The EM500 look like it does. Otherwise it's going to be hard to determine the functions of the ic.
